review.tagline: Electron desktop workbench for Claude Code with diff review and multi-session tabs
review.summary: cc-haha is an Electron and React desktop app for macOS, Windows and Linux that wraps a Claude Code-style agent runtime built on Bun. It adds multi-session tabs, per-file diff review, an in-app browser preview, graphical permission approval, MCP and SubAgent management, and Computer Use. Models can be Claude, ChatGPT or Grok accounts, third-party APIs such as DeepSeek, Kimi and GLM, or local endpoints in LM Studio and Ollama.
review.audience: Developers wanting a GUI for Claude Code-style agents with any model
strengths: Installers for macOS, Windows and Linux; CLI also runs from source with Bun
Model choice includes Claude, ChatGPT, Grok, DeepSeek, Kimi, GLM, LM Studio and Ollama
Per-file syntax-highlighted diffs, with the whole turn revertible
Remote access via phone browser (H5) and IM bridges such as Telegram, Slack and Feishu
weaknesses: README does not state RAM or system requirements
Unsigned Windows and draft macOS builds can trigger SmartScreen or Gatekeeper prompts
README carries sponsor and affiliate promotions for third-party API resellers
Main README and most of its text are in Chinese; English is a separate file
needs: Needs Bun, Electron, Model provider API key or account
Models: Claude, ChatGPT, Grok, DeepSeek, Kimi
